参加データ・使い方について: Your data and how to participate
サイト内の読み取りボタンから設置QRを読み取ります。ニックネームに加え、生徒は学: Use the scan button on this site to scan each location's QR code. We store your nickname and stamp history, together with your grade, class and attendance number for students, or participant ID for guests. Only administrators can view progress and rankings. We do not collect real names, contact details or location data, or upload camera footage or images. The cookie and visible stamp history last 30 days. Organizers delete server records after the festival. Use the same device and browser. If you delete cookies or change devices, sign in with your nickname and recovery code. If you lose the code, issue a new one on the original device or contact reception.
